text: GTA 6 on PC might be coming a lot sooner than you think. GamesBeat just reported that the PC version could launch in the first quarter of 2027. That's only a few months after the console release on November nineteenth. The source? Four industry insiders, all anonymous. Now compare that to history. GTA 5 took nineteen months to reach PC. Red Dead Redemption 2 took thirteen. A gap of a few months would break Rockstar's pattern completely. But here's the twist. Take-Two's own release schedule for this fiscal year lists GTA 6 only on PS Five and Xbox Series X and S. No PC at all. And Rockstar hasn't said a word. So heads up: this is a rumor, not confirmed. Would you wait for the PC version, or play on console day one? Tell me below.
